blocks.text: Shenzhen, China—China, the United States, and Russia issued a “Declaration toward Peace” on Thursday after their leaders held an unprecedented summit, laying out common ambitions to overhaul the UN and keep the International Criminal Court in check. The statement after Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin met in China said they wanted to protect diplomatic immunity for state officials and also boost supply and production of refined petroleum products. “The three heads of state had an in-depth exchange of views on the current international situation and committed to maintaining strategic stability and international security,” a White House version of the statement […]...
